facts.fact: The report says the Plan National du Numérique 'Horizon 2025' resulted from a validation workshop in Kinshasa on 3 September 2019, with four pillars (infrastructure, content, application uses, governance and regulation); on 20 June 2025 the president told the Council of Ministers that satellite projects fall within it. No adopting act is named.

systems.tiers: national; digital development strategy to 2025, four pillars
